summary.text: Maureen Bauer is a Democratic state representative from Indiana House District 6, which she has represented since November 2020, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her as the only candidate in the general election for the seat.

paragraphs.text: Maureen Bauer was born in South Bend, Indiana, and graduated from John Adams High School.
She earned an associate degree from Lake Michigan College and a bachelor's degree from Indiana University Purdue University at Indianapolis.

Her career experience includes working as a manager of global accounts with HelmsBriscoe and owning a business, and she has served with the Indiana Farm Bureau and the Great Lakes Sustainable Wine Alliance.
In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, she said she had four years of experience working at the Statehouse for the Indiana House of Representatives.
Bauer took office on November 4, 2020, succeeding B. Patrick Bauer.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists her on the Courts and Criminal Code, House Environmental Affairs, House Judiciary and Public Health committees.
In the 2020 survey, she said her priorities included a healthcare system that is accessible and affordable for all, including lower prescription drug costs and expanded mental health coverage.
